summary: Ameris Bancorp files Form 8-K Item 8.01 to disclose a jury verdict against its subsidiary, Ameris Bank, in a wrongful termination and whistleblower lawsuit filed by former employee Patrick Byrne. The jury awarded $16.525M in damages plus $62.9M in punitive damages. The company disagrees with the verdict and plans to appeal. This is litigation disclosure, not a special situation event.
